messages.text: Searched the catalog · Magic Miner 40T Harlo B30
Looked up for Sarah: Both live: Harlo B30 $899, 30 TH/s; Magic Miner 40T $799, now Batch 6, 50 units — 40 TH/s, best value per terahash.
Hey, it's Sarah! I see you're weighing the Magic Miner 40T and the Harlo B30. Tell me a bit about where it'll run and I'll tell you which
which one's quieter? it's going in my home office
Looked up for Sarah: Both spec ~50 dB — B30 at 360–450W flat; the 40T only hits 50 dB in Eco at 30 TH/s, louder at 40 or 50.
is the B30 actually in stock right now, and when would it ship?
Looked up for Sarah: B30 is pre-sale, not shelf stock — it's buyable now and a new order ships November 30, 2026. Says "ships", not delivers.

Yes, you can order it now, but it's a pre-order. New B30 orders ship November 30th, and honestly, B30 dates have slipped before. On noise, the B30 stays around fifty decibels all the time. The 40T is only that quiet in Eco
Looked up for Sarah: Ask one closing question: "Before you go, one thing: what's keeping you from ordering the 40T today?" — they've circled it for weeks.
